The Censor (`qa-lead`) does not sign the spec gate: that belongs to the architect, and the Censor’s initial cascade work is advisory. The Censor is the independent, read-only, sole `review`/QA gate. ([bisellium-main/studio/leges/qa.md:8-12](#), [bisellium-main/studio/decisions/D-014.md:31-45](#))

Under the latest D-014 correction, the Censor runs as `gpt-5.6-sol` at high reasoning effort; the architect signs `spec` on `gpt-6-astra` at medium effort. ([bisellium-main/studio/decisions/D-014.md:84-90](#))

This change is prospective: existing Astra- and Opus-model review records remain accepted, and none are rewritten or re-signed. The gate and independence requirements remain unchanged. ([bisellium-main/studio/decisions/D-014.md:61-68](#), [bisellium-main/studio/decisions/D-014.md:75-80](#), [bisellium-main/studio/decisions/D-014.md:84-90](#))
